lines.text: The burrower got you again. No, don't apologize, this is useful. Walk me through it. Where were you standing when the ground came up?
Middle of the room, like a fool.

Like most people. Feet want open ground, but open ground is where it looks first. Keep a wall near your back and watch the floor, not the thing. I'd drill it with you, but I'm not allowed in. So drill it yourself.
